def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    # 1. Позиции, совершённые строго до seed_time
    items = order_items[order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids) & (order_items['ts'] < seed_time)]
    items = items.merge(orders[['order_id', 'customer_id']], on='order_id', how='left')

    # 2. Отзывы: только те, что уже созданы к моменту seed_time
    rev_ok = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    rev_agg = rev_ok.groupby('order_id').agg(
        mean_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        cnt_review=('review_score', 'count')
    ).reset_index()

    # 3. Платежи: только по заказам, купленным до seed_time
    pay_ok = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time]
    pay_agg = pay_ok.groupby('order_id').agg(
        sum_paid=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        cnt_payments=('payment_sequential', 'count'),
        mean_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean')
    ).reset_index()

    items = items.merge(rev_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    items = items.merge(pay_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    # 4. Базовая агрегация по всей доступной истории
    base = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
        cnt_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        cnt_items=('order_item_id', 'count'),
        sum_price=('price', 'sum'),
        mean_price=('price', 'mean'),
        std_price=('price', 'std'),
        min_price=('price', 'min'),
        max_price=('price', 'max'),
        mean_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        sum_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        cnt_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
        cnt_customers=('customer_id', 'nunique'),
        mean_review_score=('mean_score', 'mean'),
        cnt_reviews=('cnt_review', 'sum'),
        sum_paid=('sum_paid', 'sum'),
        cnt_payments=('cnt_payments', 'sum'),
        mean_installments=('mean_installments', 'mean')
    ).reset_index()

    base = base.set_index('product_id')

    # 5. Оконные признаки
    for N in [14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
        lo = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=N)
        sub = items[(items['ts'] >= lo) & (items['ts'] < seed_time)]
        g = sub.groupby('product_id')
        base[f'orders_{N}d'] = g['order_id'].nunique().reindex(base.index, fill_value=0)
        base[f'revenue_{N}d'] = g['price'].sum().reindex(base.index, fill_value=0)
        base[f'items_{N}d'] = g['order_item_id'].count().reindex(base.index, fill_value=0)
        base[f'reviews_{N}d'] = g['cnt_review'].sum().reindex(base.index, fill_value=0)
        base[f'mean_review_{N}d'] = g['mean_score'].mean().reindex(base.index, fill_value=0.0)
        base[f'cust_{N}d'] = g['customer_id'].nunique().reindex(base.index, fill_value=0)

    # 6. Recency и возраст продукта
    last_ts = items.groupby('product_id')['ts'].max().reindex(base.index)
    first_ts = items.groupby('product_id')['ts'].min().reindex(base.index)
    base['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - last_ts).dt.days
    base['days_since_first'] = (seed_time - first_ts).dt.days

    # 7. Тренды активности (соотношение окон)
    eps = 1.0
    base['trend_30_90'] = (base['orders_30d'] + eps) / (base['orders_90d'] + eps)
    base['trend_90_365'] = (base['orders_90d'] + eps) / (base['orders_365d'] + eps)
    base['rev_trend_30_90'] = (base['revenue_30d'] + eps) / (base['revenue_90d'] + eps)

    # 8. Относительная частота внутри месяца
    base['orders_per_active_day'] = base['cnt_orders'] / (base['days_since_first'] + 1.0)

    base = base.reindex(entity_ids)
    base = base.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)

    return base
